records.name: Marischal College
records.description: Vast granite landmark that anchors Aberdeen's civic centre and showcases the city's nickname, the Granite City.

records.name: King's College Aberdeen
records.description: Late-medieval university complex in Old Aberdeen, famous for its crown tower and chapel.

records.name: Aberdeen Art Gallery
records.description: Major gallery with Scottish art, design collections and a finely restored Victorian interior.

records.name: Aberdeen Maritime Museum
records.description: Harbourfront museum exploring shipbuilding, fishing and the North Sea oil story through striking displays.

records.name: Provost Skene's House
records.description: Restored 16th-century townhouse telling the stories of people who shaped Aberdeen and Scotland.

records.name: St Machar's Cathedral
records.description: Ancient granite cathedral in Old Aberdeen noted for its heraldic ceiling and centuries of church history.

records.name: Union Street
records.description: Aberdeen's grand main street, lined with granite buildings, shops, civic landmarks and theatres.

records.name: Aberdeen Beach
records.description: Long sandy city beach backed by esplanades and big North Sea skies, popular for walks and sunrises.

records.name: Duthie Park
records.description: One of Aberdeen's best-loved parks, with lawns, boating ponds and access to the winter gardens.

records.name: David Welch Winter Gardens
records.description: Large indoor gardens filled with tropical plants, cacti, seasonal displays and sheltered walkways.
records.address: Duthie Park, Polmuir Road, Aberdeen AB11 7TH

records.name: Seaton Park
records.description: Spacious riverside park near Old Aberdeen, known for formal flower beds and walks to the River Don.

records.name: Hazlehead Park
records.description: Huge west-end park with woodland paths, sculptures, gardens and family-friendly open space.

records.name: The Gordon Highlanders Museum
records.description: Military museum covering the history and global service of the Gordon Highlanders regiment.
records.address: St Luke's, Viewfield Road, Aberdeen AB15 7XH

records.name: Aberdeen Science Centre
records.description: Hands-on science centre with interactive exhibits aimed at families and curious young visitors.

records.name: Pittodrie Stadium
records.description: Historic home of Aberdeen FC, a football landmark closely tied to the city's sporting identity.

records.name: Old Aberdeen
records.description: Atmospheric quarter of cobbled lanes, university buildings and old kirkyards that preserves medieval Aberdeen.

records.name: Footdee
records.description: Characterful fishing quarter of tiny lanes and decorated cottages at the edge of the harbour.

records.name: Aberdeen Harbour
records.description: Busy historic port where ferries, offshore vessels and fishing heritage meet the modern working waterfront.

records.name: Victoria Bridge
records.description: Elegant 19th-century bridge over the River Dee linking the south side with central Aberdeen.

records.name: Union Terrace Gardens
records.description: Sunken city-centre gardens offering a green pause beside theatres, galleries and granite streets.

records.name: His Majesty's Theatre
records.description: Edwardian theatre and one of northeast Scotland's leading venues for touring productions.

records.name: Music Hall Aberdeen
records.description: Classical concert hall on Union Street hosting music, comedy and civic cultural events.

records.name: Provost Ross's House
records.description: One of Aberdeen's oldest houses, now forming part of the Maritime Museum complex.

records.name: Tolbooth Museum
records.description: Former jail and courthouse where exhibitions explore grim episodes from Aberdeen's legal past.

records.name: Johnston Gardens
records.description: Compact landscaped gardens with streams, bridges and quiet corners tucked into the west end.

records.name: Donmouth Local Nature Reserve
records.description: Dunes, estuary and wildlife-rich shoreline where the River Don meets the North Sea.

records.name: Brig o' Balgownie
records.description: Picturesque medieval bridge spanning the River Don and linked to many local legends.

records.name: Girdle Ness Lighthouse
records.description: Striking Stevenson lighthouse on a rocky headland with wide views over the harbour approaches.

records.name: Kirk of St Nicholas
records.description: Historic city-centre kirk with a long ecclesiastical history and a distinctive central setting.

records.name: Cruickshank Botanic Garden
records.description: University botanic garden with alpine, herbaceous and native plant collections in Old Aberdeen.

records.name: Torry Battery
records.description: Napoleonic-era battery and superb lookout point for harbour traffic and occasional dolphin sightings.

records.name: Aberdeen Arts Centre
records.description: Intimate performing-arts venue in a former church with a strong community and festival role.

records.name: Mercat Cross
records.description: Historic market cross that marks the ceremonial heart of old Aberdeen's burgh centre.

records.name: Aberdeen Town House
records.description: Granite civic headquarters crowned by a tall spire and dominating Broad Street.

records.name: Beach Ballroom
records.description: Art Deco dance hall and seaside entertainment landmark on the promenade.

records.name: Westburn Park
records.description: Popular local park with open lawns, mature trees and room for relaxed outdoor time.

records.name: Queen Victoria Statue
records.description: Prominent city-centre statue recalling Aberdeen's Victorian prosperity and civic confidence.

records.name: St Andrew's Cathedral
records.description: Scottish Episcopal cathedral known for its graceful Gothic revival design near the city centre.

records.name: Powis Gates
records.description: Ornate gateway beside the university that adds to the ceremonial feel of Old Aberdeen.

records.name: Wellington Suspension Bridge
records.description: Slender suspension bridge over the Dee offering a handsome industrial-age river crossing.
